overview_description.description:
Bonfire is the leading next-generation competitive bidding and RFx platform.  

Bonfire goes beyond the basic automation of eProcurement suites and older simple bidding tools, helping you to make better, faster decisions.  It’s a collaborative, powerful, and insightful cloud-based platform for today’s procurement needs.

Bonfire streamlines your entire RFx and bidding process, helping you run projects up to 50% faster.  Bonfire empowers you with unparalleled evaluation features for deeper analysis, delivered through our distinctly intuitive and easy-to-use platform.

Bonfire is trusted with over a billion dollars of supplier selection decisions per month, and is one of the fastest growing new procurement technologies.

Learn how easier collaboration, richer data, and smarter automation can transform your competitive bidding and RFx projects by visiting GoBonfire.com.

product.name: Euna Procurement
product.description: A cloud-based procurement software that manages the entire procurement lifecycle, including sourcing, contracting, purchasing, and invoicing for public sector organizations.

product.name: Euna Sourcing
product.description: A module within Euna Procurement that facilitates the creation, evaluation, and awarding of bids and solicitations for public sector procurement.

product.name: Euna Contracting
product.description: A contract management tool integrated with procurement processes to manage contract creation, performance monitoring, and stakeholder collaboration.

product.name: Euna Marketplace
product.description: A centralized platform for staff to shop approved contracts, ensuring on-contract spending and compliance within public sector organizations.

product.name: Euna Invoicing
product.description: An accounts payable automation tool that streamlines invoice collection, processing, and reconciliation for public sector procurement.

product.name: Euna Supplier Management
product.description: A supplier management system that supports supplier registration, performance tracking, and engagement without charging suppliers fees.
